Eskimo.question: In Siberia, about 300 of a total of 900 _____ people still learn and study the language, though it is no longer learned as a first language by children
Eskimo.fact: About 1,050 of a total Alaska population of 1,100 Siberian Yupik people in Alaska speak the language. In Siberia, about 300 of a total of 900 Siberian Yupik people still learn and study the language, though it is no longer learned as a first language by children.
